visual.description: Warm sage-khaki textured background that fills the hero and sets the dominant brand atmosphere.
Warm off-white used for nav text, cookie banner text, and light surface elements.
Deep near-black used for the navigation pill bar and cookie consent banner background.
Warm off-white text used inside the dark navigation bar for logo and menu labels.
Warm off-white used for nav links and interactive text elements within the dark nav bar.
Same deep near-black — nav does not change color on scroll; both states are identical.
Same warm off-white in scrolled state — nav text is consistent across scroll states.
Same off-white nav links in scrolled state.
Very dark near-black used for the large display heading 'Putting the Power Back in Your Hands'.
Dark warm-toned color used for body paragraph text in the hero section.
Vivid green used for the 'Low' energy usage badge — the primary brand accent and status color.
Near-pure black used for borders and fine detail elements.
